purpose: Standalone ancient gnarled tree for two prominent positions in the temple forest
reference_generation: OpenAI built-in image generation; full prompt in reference-prompt.txt
limitations: Two trees retain their original trunk colliders. The source canopy is denser and less arching than the art reference, and individual LOD transitions and displayed FPS have not been measured.
web_review: Front, side and rear rotated in the same job IAB viewer; root silhouette and textured bark visible, canopy compressed relative to reference. The Unity camera review also checked a close root view.
